newsitem.title: UK: ICI has $8.5 bln loan, S&P rates co at A-.
newsitem.headline: ICI has $8.5 bln loan, S&P rates co at A-.

text.p: Imperial Chemical Industries Plc said on Wednesday it had put in place a new five-year loan facility totalling $8.5 billion to fund its purchase of Unilever's speciality chemicals businesses.
It said Standard & Poors had indicated that ICI's long-term debt credit rating would be A- following the acquisition.
The loan is bing arranged jointly by Goldman Sachs International, HSBC Group and SBC Warburg.

ICI said it expected to be able to reduce its total borrowing levels significantly through the early stages of its divestment programme, through which it expects to raise three billion stg over three years.
Foreign exchange and interest rate exposures in connection with the Unilever acquisition and its financing have been hedged.
